description: Wait for a check (or a confirm_fix re-check) and read its result: how many problems a new user would hit, the title of each and how serious it is (blocking, serious or minor), and how to have it fixed ($79, paid up front); for an app already paid for, what a new user saw, where, the likely cause, the fix prompt and how to know it is fixed. Answers within about 20 seconds: the result, or that the check is still running and about how many minutes are left; then call it again with the same check_id a minute later.
name: get_check_result
title: Read what the check found
